messages:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-67934 posted for OrbitStream — total $11,964.52 (usage + embeddings). Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-67934

rachel (Finance): OrbitStream disputed a $2,800 spike on 2025-06-18. They say requests were routed twice during our autoscaling rollout and were billed for duplicated inference tokens.

jared (Billing Ops): Pulling usage. We see two nearly identical request batches at 2025-06-18 04:12 and 04:13 UTC from the same api-key and identical prompt hashes. Looks like duplicate routing to primary+canary pools.

ivan (Eng Runtime): We deployed autoscale routing change 06/18 04:00 that accidentally had `retry_on_no_ack = true` plus a new router rule; under load the router retried and fanout to both pools for ~70s. Root cause confirmed. Patch landed at 06/18 04:15.

priya (Sales): OrbitStream is an SMB signed on Feb pilot. They're sensitive to invoice surprises — we promised flexible support. They asked for full removal of the duplicated charge.

emma (Customer Success): Customer provided request ids and server logs. They prefer a credit on next invoice rather than refund.

rachel (Finance): Estimated duplicated tokens = 3,500,000 -> at their blended $0.0008/token = $2,800. Recommend one-time credit memo CM-8122 for $2,800 and reissue INV-67934 -> INV-67934-R.

jared (Billing Ops): Will create CM once we have Finance Lead approval and a short engineering RCA note attached. Also need GL and journal id.

cory (Finance Lead): I approve one-time credit $2,800 as customer-first remediation. Conditions: label `routing-fanout-duplicate-credit`, GL 4115, journal CRD-ORBIT-20250620, attach eng RCA and mark as "engineer-confirmed root cause". Legal to be looped if vendor impact.

legal-bot: Noted legal hold: if repeated incidents cause systemic billing variance >$20k over 90 days we escalate. Will track.

ivan (Eng Runtime): RCA summary: router config coupled with `retry_on_no_ack` created duplicate fanout under median p95 latency spike; patched router to use idempotent request keys and disabled auto-retry during rollout windows. Adding alert for duplicate request signature rate. Logs attached to CS ticket.

emma (Customer Success): I'll notify OrbitStream: credit is approved and will appear on next invoice, include short tech note and mitigation steps. They asked for a written assurance we won't auto-scale rollouts without a safe-guard; Priya will confirm sales promise.

priya (Sales): I'll add a CRM note committing to an extra warm-window and notify the customer. Also will add this to the pilot SLA addendum.

jared (Billing Ops): Creating credit memo CM-8122 for $2,800.00 and reissuing INV-67934 -> INV-67934-R. Journal entry: `CRD-ORBIT-20250620 | GL 4115 | Amount 2800.00 | Note: routing fanout duplicate credit`.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-8122 created for INV-67934-R amount $2,800.00 (status: pending).

rachel (Finance): Please flag CM as "one-time - engineering confirmed" so billing automation won't auto-merge into policy credits. Also attach CS ticket and RCA.

cory (Finance Lead): Good resolution. Keep vendor/engineering review in loop and close once CM posts. :white_check_mark:
